'''Vance Caelli''' was a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] and [[Arms dealer/Legends|arms dealer]] who was a member of the [[Black Bha'lir]] organization. Together with fellow Black Bha'lir member [[Rondale Merced]], Caelli formed the [[Caelli-Merced Syndicate]] corporation, which was based on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Socorro/Legends|Socorro]] and manufactured illegal [[Weapon/Legends|weapons]] as well as ground vehicles and [[Starship/Legends|starship]] upgrade components. Caelli and Merced both disappeared under mysterious circumstances at some point following the [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|destruction]] of the planet [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], leaving their [[Gender/Legends|nephew]] [[Pret Swain]] as the sole leader of the Caelli-Merced Syndicate.

==Biography==
[[File:Pret_Swain.png|thumb|right|250px|Pret Swain (pictured) was the nephew of Vance Caelli and Rondale Merced.]]
A notorious [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] and [[Arms dealer/Legends|weapons dealer]], Vance Caelli was an important member of the smuggler and [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] organization [[Black Bha'lir]], which was based in the [[Socorro system/Legends|Socorro]] and [[Omman Minor system/Legends|Omman Minor systems]]<ref name="Socorro" /> of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> They and their fellow Black Bha'lir member [[Rondale Merced]]&mdash;also known as Lee Merced&mdash;were [[Gender/Legends|uncles]] of [[Pret Swain]], a young man from<ref name="Socorro" /> the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] planet<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]].<ref name="Socorro" />

By the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Caelli and Merced had established the highly profitable [[Caelli-Merced Syndicate]] corporation. Based on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Socorro/Legends|Socorro]], the company produced ground vehicles and [[Starship/Legends|starship]] upgrade components as well as illegal [[Weapon/Legends|weaponry]]&mdash;with it being the only weapons manufacturing enterprise on Socorro.<ref name="Socorro" />

At the time Alderaan was [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|destroyed]]<ref name="Socorro" /> by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> Caelli and Merced were being visited by Swain on Socorro. When news of the event reached the planet, the devastated [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanian]] had nowhere to turn, and his uncles offered for him to become a full partner of the Caelli-Merced Syndicate and help manage the company&mdash;an offer that Swain accepted. Caelli and Merced both disappeared at some point under mysterious circumstances, which left Swain as the sole head of the corporation and made him relatively paranoid.<ref name="Socorro" />

==Personality and traits==
Vance Caelli had a smooth and amiable personality, a trait they shared with both their partner Rondale Merced and nephew Pret Swain.<ref name="Socorro" />

==Behind the scenes==
Vance Caelli was mentioned in the [[1997]] [[West End Games]] [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] sourcebook ''[[The Black Sands of Socorro]]'', which was written by [[Patricia A. Jackson]] for use with ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="Socorro" />
